title: Ideal X and the start of container shipping
summary: On 26 April 1956 a crane loaded 58 containers onto the Ideal X, an aging tanker, at Port Newark, one every seven minutes and all in under eight hours. Five days later the ship reached Houston. It was the venture of Malcom McLean, a trucking magnate who had turned to shipping. Ocean freight had often cost 15 to 20 percent of a cargo's value, and containers opened the way to modern globalization.

uncertainty.note: Left Port Newark on 26 April 1956; the Smithsonian says it reached Houston five days later.
